items.text:
[h1] A heartbreaking waste of potential [/h1]
[b] TLDR Review: [/b] Not worth your money.

This is one of those reviews that hurts to write, truly. At a glance Ostranauts looks like an awesome game, at a glance this game looks like a GOAT in the making, at a glance this game [b] [i] should [/i] [/b] be a blast but it's just not, and sadly it's much worse than it first looks like at first glance.

There are so many issues, ranging from small, to litterally fundamental to the game's conception that I couldn't possibly list them all, so instead I'm going to hammer on the main points that I think need to be addressed. With that said, here goes.

[h2] What is wrong? [/h2]
Like I mentioned, it's a lot, but let me start with the main thing that does this game in for me, the game design itself. Now, that might sound harsh, and yes, it is, however let me explain what I mean, and why I'm so irked by this.

[h3] Pain Point #1 - A false sandbox [/h3]
So here's the first thing, Ostranauts is presented as a kind of hardcore sandbox space sim, a game in which you have to sit down and seriously consider your intentions, weigh your options, and take decisions that affect your life a spacer. Sounds cool, sounds awesome even, sign me up, I want this.

Here's the problem, all of that doesn't matter, at all, let me explain. The problem is that the salvaging gameplay loop that is intended to get you out of debt and onto Venus ends up becoming the only thing really worth doing at all, because once you do end up going to other planets the other options just can't compete, for instance trading has a pretty large buy in and can only really compete if market conditions align well, racing doesn't even scratch the surface, and mining isn't really worth it either. Now, people might want to point out "The Gigs though?", however the problem there is that the more profiatble gigs have an even bigger buy in to be profitable since they require you to build for speed in order to cash in the big bucks. As a result, you effectively become locked into salvaging gameplay for the early game AND the mid-game, with a possibility of making some okay money on an occassional trade when the stars align.

This in turn creates several problems, first is that it means that litterally every single character you make will start the game in the exact same way. Second is that it means that you end up not being able to actually experiment with different ways to play the game until you are well into a save already, at which point you are already optimized for salvaging. The third issue is that those two issues thus effectively push you towards pursuing the end-game content instead, since the mid-game content (mining, trading, racing) just isn't really worth it time/money wise in most cases. Lastly, this also essentially also kills much of they joy with character creation, since the only real skills that matter are hacking, zero-g ops, and eva specialization, in that order, every time.

All of this stemming from 1 bad decision, namely forcing the player to start as a salvager, and not giving them any other options at the start. Consider if instead the player could partake in salvaging, mining, racing, piracy, and anti-piracy early on? All of a sudden your character creation options matter. If you were able to join law enforcement or become a pirate in the early game, then combat skills would matter in the early game. If you were able to begin racing then navigational skills matter. If you were able to begin mining then mining skills matter, so on and so forth. Instead, we're left with this, truth be told, depressingly bad design choice of limiting the player to "the one thing" and nothing else.

This kind of railroad-y design unfortunately permeates the entire game, if you can do something, there's one way of doing it and no more, and most of the things you'd want to be able to do, you just can't even do at all.

[h3] Pain Point #2 - Poorly thought out and implemented systems [/h3]
The next thing that really detracts from the experience is just how disjointed the various gameplay systems are, wether poorly designed, poorly implemented, or both, Ostranauts suffers from a bad case of the player having to "fight the game" to do what they want to do in many cases. For example, if you try to rebuild your ship at a station, the Crew AI will continually walk out of the airlocks without a helmet on while on auto-task, forcing you to save them, wasting your time. At the same time, they'll refuse to do certain tasks and complain about needing EVA helmets [b] when they are already f**king wearing them [/b] and stuff like this is [b] CONSTANT[/b]. For every enjoyable moment in Ostranauts, you will have 9 others that are just frustrating, annoying, or worse.

The Crew AI in general is just a pain to manage, from their overall behaviour, to only really being able to see one crew member's needs at a time, to their behaviour when it comes to zones, to how they consistently walk outside without a helmet, it all just serves to frustrate you instead of invite deeper engagement with the system.

Another thing that "sounds cool on paper, but was implemented poorly" is the interactions system, save for a specific interaction with law enforcement, and getting better hiring prices, friendship and other relationship milestones don't really matter.

[h3] Pain Point #3 - "It doesn't matter" [/h3]
This is probably the main crux of my gripes with this game, very little that you do as a player actually matters, for a game with at first glance seemingly such potential for player driven interaction, emergent gameplay, and meaningful player agency, it has almost none of it. You're railroaded into the salvager > trader/miner/racer > combat progression, and while sure you can stop at any point in that progression, that really just means you don't get any more gameplay. Initially you're driven by a need to repay debt, but that debt will clear pretty quickly once you start salvaging smart and your ship grows so you can salvage in larger quantity too.

Combine that with the fact that most POI's are mostly empty, and with nothing really unique going on, and the issues outlined in #1 & #2 really just end up creating this feeling of apathy towards the world in general, which is sad, because the ship building and piloting is actually pretty cool.

[h3] Pain Point #4 - A sandbox game trying to serve you a story [/h3]
This I think feels more like the Developers salting the wound than anything else. You've got this wonderful setup for a sandbox game, you've got the ship building, you've got the piloting, you've got a moderately interesting character creation system, and then... you build a mostly empty world, railroad the player harder than some story driven games I've played, and make any real build beyond "Hacker with EVA Skills" litterally worthless. And then, the icing on the cake on top of that, they tack on story content that most people don't care about. Like f**k man, you were the supposed to be an emergent story & gameplay type of offering, not yet another linear story space sim.

[h3] Closing thoughts [/h3]
Ultimately, Ostranauts promises big and delivers very little, and as someone who can see the potential of the idea that hurts to see, a lot. One or two good ideas is not enough to make a game, and Ostranauts is a good example of that. Now granted, I don't think that this game beyond saving, but this is not a 1.0 game, and we're probably talking a good two years or so of contuinous work to turn this around.

[h3] Final Verdict - [b] Not worth your money [/b] [/h3]
I hope that sometime in the future, perhaps in a year or two, I can buy this game again, and revisit this review, but until the Devs sit down and have a long, hard talk with themselves, and start making sweeping changes to the gameplay and especially progression structure in favor of player agency, then I cannot in good faith recommend this game to anyone at all, sadly.
items.text_zh:
[h1] 令人心碎地浪费潜力 [/h1]
[b] 简评： [/b] 不值得你花钱。

这是那种写起来很痛的评测，真的。乍一看 Ostranauts 像是一款很棒的游戏，乍一看这款游戏像是正在成形的 GOAT，乍一看这款游戏 [b] [i] 应该 [/i] [/b] 会很好玩，但它就是不好玩，而且遗憾的是，它比乍一看时糟糕得多。

问题太多了，从小问题，到对游戏构想来说简直根本性的问题，我不可能把它们全列出来，所以我要重点敲打我认為需要解决的主要几点。话虽如此，开始吧。

[h2] 哪里出了问题？ [/h2]
就像我提到的，问题很多，但让我从对我来说毁掉这款游戏的主要原因说起，也就是游戏设计本身。现在，这听起来可能很苛刻，是的，确实苛刻，不过让我解释一下我的意思，以及我为什么对此如此恼火。

[h3] 痛点 #1 - 虚假的沙盒 [/h3]
先说第一点，Ostranauts 被呈现为一种硬核沙盒太空模拟游戏，一款你必须坐下来认真考虑自己的意图、权衡选择，并做出影响你作为太空人生活的决定的游戏。听起来很酷，听起来甚至很棒，给我报名，我想要这个。

问题在这里，所有那些都无关紧要，完全无关紧要，让我解释。问题在于，那个本意是让你摆脱债务并前往金星的打捞玩法循环，最终变成了唯一真正值得做的事情，因为一旦你真的去了其他行星，其他选项根本竞争不过，比如贸易的买入成本相当高，只有在市场条件配合得很好时才真正有竞争力，竞速连皮毛都算不上，采矿也不怎么值得。现在，人们可能会想指出“那 Gigs 呢？”，但问题在于，利润更高的 gigs 为了盈利需要更大的投入，因为它们要求你为速度而建造，才能赚到大钱。结果就是，你在前期和中期实际上都被锁死在打捞玩法里，只有在星辰对齐时偶尔做一笔贸易赚点还行的钱。

这反过来又造成了几个问题，第一是这意味着你创建的每一个角色都会以完全相同的方式开始游戏。第二是这意味着你在存档已经进行得很深入之前，实际上无法尝试不同的玩法，而到那时你已经为打捞优化好了。第三个问题是，这两个问题因此实际上把你推向追求终局内容，因为中期内容（采矿、贸易、竞速）在大多数情况下从时间/金钱角度看并不真正值得。最后，这也基本上扼杀了角色创建的大部分乐趣，因为唯一真正重要的技能是黑客、零重力操作和 EVA 专精，按这个顺序，每次都是。

所有这一切都源于 1 个糟糕的决定，也就是强迫玩家以打捞者身份开局，并且一开始不给他们任何其他选择。试想一下，如果玩家一开始就能参与打捞、采矿、竞速、海盗和反海盗呢？突然之间，你的角色创建选项就有意义了。如果你能在前期加入执法部门或成为海盗，那么战斗技能在前期就有意义。如果你能开始竞速，那么导航技能就有意义。如果你 
能够开始采矿，那么采矿技能就重要了，以此类推。相反，我们得到的却是这个，说实话，令人沮丧的糟糕设计选择，把玩家限制在“唯一的一件事”上，别的什么都不行。

这种铁轨式的设计不幸地渗透了整个游戏，如果你能做某件事，那就只有一种做法，没有别的，而大多数你想做的事情，你根本连做都做不了。

[h3] 痛点 #2 - 考虑不周且实现糟糕的系统 [/h3]
下一个真正损害体验的地方，就是各种玩法系统之间有多么脱节，无论是设计糟糕、实现糟糕，还是两者兼有，Ostranauts 都患上了严重的毛病：在很多情况下，玩家为了做自己想做的事，不得不“和游戏对抗”。例如，如果你试图在空间站重建你的飞船，船员 AI 会在自动执行任务时不断不戴头盔走出气闸，逼着你去救他们，浪费你的时间。与此同时，他们会拒绝执行某些任务，并抱怨需要 EVA 头盔，[b]而他们他妈的已经戴着了[/b]，诸如此类的事情[b]层出不穷[/b]。在 Ostranauts 中，每有一个愉快的时刻，就会有另外 9 个只是令人沮丧、恼火，或者更糟的时刻。

总体而言，船员 AI 管理起来就是一件痛苦的事，从他们的整体行为，到一次只能真正看到一个船员的需求，到他们在区域方面的行为，再到他们总是能不戴头盔走到外面，这一切都只会让你感到挫败，而不是邀请你更深入地参与这个系统。

另一件“纸面上听起来很酷，但实现得很糟糕”的东西是互动系统，除了与执法部门的一个特定互动，以及获得更好的雇佣价格之外，友谊和其他关系里程碑其实并不重要。

[h3] 痛点 #3 - “这根本不重要” [/h3]
这可能是我对这款游戏不满的主要症结，作为玩家，你所做的很少真正重要，对于一款乍看之下似乎有如此潜力实现玩家驱动互动、涌现式玩法以及有意义的玩家能动性的游戏来说，它几乎一点都没有。你被强行推入打捞者 > 商人/矿工/赛车手 > 战斗的进程，当然你可以在这一进程中的任何一点停下来，但那实际上只意味着你再也得不到更多玩法了。起初你被偿还债务的需求驱动，但一旦你开始聪明地打捞，那笔债务很快就会还清，而且你的飞船也会成长，于是你也能更大批量地打捞。

再结合大多数兴趣点基本都是空的，而且没有什么真正独特的事情发生，再加上 #1 和 #2 中概述的问题，最终真的只会让人对这个世界产生一种冷漠感，这很可悲，因为飞船建造和驾驶其实相当酷。

[h3] 痛点 #4 - 一款试图给你端上剧情的沙盒游戏 [/h3]
我觉得这更像是开发者在伤口上撒盐，而不是别的什么。你有一个绝佳的沙盒游戏框架，你有飞船建造，你有驾驶，你有一个还算有趣的角色创建系统，然后……你建造了一个基本空无一物的世界，把玩家强行推得比我玩过的一些剧情驱动游戏还厉害，并让任何真正超出“带 EVA 技能的黑客”的构筑都变得毫无价值。然后，在此之上锦上添花的是，他们还硬塞上大多数人根本不在乎的剧情内容。
搞什么鬼啊，老兄，你本该是一款涌现式故事与玩法类型的作品，而不是又一个线性剧情的太空模拟游戏。

[h3] 结语 [/h3]
最终，Ostranauts 承诺了很多，兑现的却极少，而作为一个能看出这个点子潜力的人，看到这一点让我非常痛心，非常痛。一两个好点子不足以做成一款游戏，Ostranauts 就是一个很好的例子。当然，我不认为这款游戏已经无可救药，但这不是一款 1.0 游戏，我们大概需要持续工作两年左右才能扭转局面。

[h3] 最终裁决 - [b] 不值得你花钱 [/b] [/h3]
我希望在未来的某个时候，也许一两年后，我能再次买下这款游戏，并重新审视这篇评测，但在开发者坐下来跟自己进行一场漫长而艰难的谈话，并开始对玩法、尤其是进度结构进行大刀阔斧的改动，以利于玩家自主权之前，我无法凭良心向任何人推荐这款游戏，很遗憾。

items.text:
[h1] 8/10 Recommended if you're acoustic [/h1]
[i] It used to be a negative review, however now its an optimistic recommended review only if you know what youre buying. I seriously do not recommend buying this blind, watch a video on Youtube comrade. [/i]

[h2]The Good [/h2]
[b]Uniqueness:[/b] Usually this catagory is for the top artistery bs or posers talking about why their ♥♥♥♥♥♥ pixel art game is so good. This is one of the exceptions where there truly is nothing like this on the $300 Billion dollar gaming market. It's like the game is set in the lore of the game Hardspace: Shipbreaker, and with the world building of NeoScavanger (Same dev).
[b]Depth: [/b] The game has incredible depth that's chosen by how much the player wishes to explore the lore. There is quests and yadada every game has it however, this game really let's you live out your dream, be a ship scrapper, pirate, living in stations, different planets and so on. 
[b]Game Size:[/b] Game is [u]2GB[/u], I can ♥♥♥♥♥ all i want but for this much content under 2GB my hats to you for making such a playable game for this game size. The game is also playable on literal hopeium which is amazing considering the pricing out of gamers in the gaming market.
[b]Tutorial:[/b] Mostly a positive, this game requires you to read the tutorial. This is not a battlefield game where the tutorial is filler. The tutorial guides you pretty well but you can still get stuck, which is why it needs to do even more handholding. This game also offers tutorials via books in the game ensuring further immersion. However the text heavy nature of the tutorials forces off platform tutorial.

[h2]The Bad [/h2]
[b]Bugs:[/b] Just like pre-release there is still a problem with the garbage collection and commands. The longer you play the game the more likely you will encounter something. People talk about CTD which i experienced pre-release and ive yet to meet it in my 10 hours, vs the 2 hours pre release. You will probably encounter framerate issues [10 fps] which again come from the garbage collection, however I did reload and it seems to have fixed it for now. 
[b]Grind:[/b] The grind should be more customizable, difficulty, and so on. In this game you can choose perks and that's fine, and there's a lot of ways to save yourself such as teleporting your ship and so on. However the grind on leveling up the character or the time it takes to build something is hellish. 

[h1] Conclusion [/h1]
Game is pretty good, I recommend it if you've played Project Zomboid, try it out. There are some serious die hard fans for this game so I recommend reading the negative reviews as they are way more informative. This game with a few QOL updates and the major update they're talking about will turn into a 9/10.
items.text_zh:
[h1] 8/10 如果你是“声学”玩家就推荐 [/h1]
[i] 这曾经是个差评，但现在它是个乐观的推荐好评，前提是你知道自己买的是什么。我强烈不建议盲买，同志，去YouTube上看个视频吧。 [/i]

[h2]优点 [/h2]
[b]独特性：[/b] 通常这个类别都是给那些顶级艺术废话或者装逼犯谈论为什么他们那♥♥♥♥♥♥像素艺术游戏有多好。这是少数例外之一，在3000亿美元的 gaming 市场上确实没有类似的东西。就像游戏设定在《Hardspace: Shipbreaker》的传说中，并且有NeoScavanger（同一开发者）的世界构建。
[b]深度：[/b] 游戏有着令人难以置信的深度，取决于玩家想探索多少传说。有任务和诸如此类的东西，每个游戏都有，然而，这个游戏真的让你实现梦想，成为拆船工、海盗、生活在空间站、不同星球等等。 
[b]游戏大小：[/b] 游戏是[u]2GB[/u]，我可以♥♥♥♥♥随便我，但对于2GB以下这么多内容，我向你们致敬，为这个游戏大小制作出如此可玩的游戏。这个游戏还能在字面意义上的“希望素”上运行，考虑到 gaming 市场上玩家的定价，这太惊人了。
[b]教程：[/b] 大多是正面的，这个游戏要求你阅读教程。这不是战地游戏，教程是填充物。教程引导得相当好，但你仍然可能卡住，这就是为什么它需要更多的牵手指导。这个游戏还通过游戏内的书籍提供教程，确保进一步的沉浸感。然而，教程的文本繁重性质迫使人们使用平台外教程。

[h2]缺点 [/h2]
[b]Bug：[/b] 就像预发布版一样，垃圾回收和命令仍然有问题。你玩得越久，越可能遇到问题。人们谈论CTD，我在预发布版经历过，但在我的10小时里还没遇到，对比预发布版的2小时。你可能会遇到帧率问题[10 fps]，这同样来自垃圾回收，然而我重新加载了，似乎暂时修复了。 
[b]刷：[/b] 刷应该更可定制，难度等等。在这个游戏里你可以选择特权，这没问题，还有很多方法拯救自己，比如传送你的飞船等等。然而，升级角色或建造某物所需时间的刷是地狱般的。 

[h1] 结论 [/h1]
游戏相当不错，如果你玩过《Project Zomboid》，我推荐试试。这个游戏有一些严肃的死忠粉丝，所以我推荐阅读负面评论，因为它们信息量更大。这个游戏通过一些QOL更新和他们谈论的重大更新将变成9/10。

items.text:
At the moment I can't recommend this. Updates are steady/slow and its still got a lot of work left. From features and bug fixes, and definitely AI improvements. But the worst problem IMO is the way they decided to implement 'Character Creation'. 

Character Creation is like doing D&D dice rolls, where almost everything (Be it positive or negative) is randomly generated. Also you don't even start with a blank character slate, instead your character starts out with 8 negative traits which you can trade "skill points" years of your age to negate. If that sounds confusing, just buy the game and try the character creation within the 2 hours. Also, aside from character creation there is no other kinds of 'progression'. So for example if you have a negative trait, you're stuck with it till you die and create a new char.
items.text_zh:
目前我不能推荐这款游戏。更新稳定但缓慢，而且还有很多工作要做。从功能和bug修复，到肯定还有AI改进。但在我看来最糟糕的问题是，他们决定采用的“角色创建”方式。

角色创建就像在玩D&D掷骰子，几乎一切（无论是正面还是负面）都是随机生成的。而且你甚至不是从一张空白的角色表开始，相反，你的角色一开始就带有8个负面特质，你可以用“技能点”或年龄来抵消它们。如果这听起来让人困惑，那就买下游戏，在两小时内试试角色创建。另外，除了角色创建之外，没有其他任何形式的“成长”。所以举个例子，如果你有一个负面特质，你就会一直带着它，直到你死掉并创建一个新角色。

observations.description: 角色创建几乎全部随机生成，正面或负面特质都靠随机骰子决定
observations.evidence: Character Creation is like doing D&D dice rolls, where almost everything (Be it positive or negative) is randomly generated.

observations.description: 角色初始自带8个负面特质，需要消耗技能点或年龄来抵消
observations.evidence: you don't even start with a blank character slate, instead your character starts out with 8 negative traits which you can trade "skill points" years of your age to negate

items.text:
本作は、非常に考えさせられるゲームである。何が面白いのかがよくわからないからである。初めの90分間で面白いところが一つも無いことに私は驚かされたが、10時間プレイしてもやはり面白いところが一つも無い。だから本作は、まるで読み方を知らない人間には無価値な文字の羅列にすぎない詩のように、詩的なゲームなのだと考えるべきではないかと思う。

たとえていうなら、現在にあって「Aボタンを押すとマリオがジャンプする」ことに感動する人は稀だと思うが、そのような既に多くの作品においては述べられることがない原始的な感動をこそ本作は主張しているようである。宇宙を舞台に次々に飛び回るゲームでありながら、操船はなぜかほとんど手動であり、宇宙船の進路決定やドッキングするための位置合わせを上下左右・回転キーで細やかに操作する必要がある。宇宙船を自在に飛ばす技術が存在する世界観であるにも関わらず自動操船ができないことは理解しがたいため、むしろこの手動操船システムが本作における重要なポイントなのだと考えるほかない。だが、煩雑な操作が要求され、時間がかかるばかりで利益が何もない移動は、少なくとも私にとっては愉快なものではなかった。移動先で、あるいは移動中に、どんな事件が起こるのかが主要な問題であり、そこに集中できる作りであってほしかったと思う。

宇宙空間の特定の座標に（なぜか）静止している船舶やステーションの残骸まで移動して乗り込むと、一部の再利用可能な装置を回収できる。これにはゲーム内時間というより現実の時間と手間がだいぶかかる。船外活動時には酸素の補充のため船に何度も戻るなど細かい操作が必要になり、また何も操作しない待ち時間もかかる。ではそうした装置をなぜ回収するのかというと、売り払って金にするためである、まずそのように私は思った。しかし一方で、簡単なおつかいミッションを受注してこなせばスカベンジの10倍くらい金になり、労力は大してかからない。つまり、実はスカベンジは金のために行うものではない。生存に必要な食糧や水は買えば豊富に手に入るゲームである。それでは、そもそも何のために敢えて残骸の回収業をするのだろうか？　たとえ無傷のエアーポンプを回収できたところで、自分の船のポンプは安定稼働しており、売っても大して利益にならず、メリットが特にないように思える。以上のように、本作の目玉要素であるはずのスカベンジをする明確な意義を理解することがまず難しい(*)。

(*) 船の拡張には役立つのかもしれない。ただ、スカベンジが金にならないことがわかっているのに、なぜスカベンジのために必要以上に倉庫を拡張するべきなのだろう？　ミッションとスカベンジの利益の差について見直したほうがよいと考えられる。

他にも、前作『NEO Scavenger』やその他「サバイバルゲーム」にもみられるリアリティの欠如は相変わらずみられる。まず、物品の非現実的な劣化速度は健在である。私の意見としては、サバイバルとは一言でいえば「買えば済むだけのものが買えない状況」に起因するものである。したがって、本作で依然みられるような「物は沢山あるが、なぜか早く劣化する」というゲームデザインは、開発陣の思考の放棄に由来するものとして私は否定的である。また本作では、宇宙船開発等にかかわる企業の存在がほのめかされているものの経済は機能しないようである。シミュレーションにおいてリアリティが欠如すると、現実的な計画を機能させることは難しくなり、プレイヤーのやることが単にゲームの癖をつかむことへと貶められてしまう。

ゲームの初めにはプレイヤーキャラクターの作成を行うが、そこで驚かされたのは、ゲームに不利な身体的特質を大量に保有している状態が初期設定として固定されている、ということだった。前作『NEO Scavenger』を思い出してみれば、不利な特質は有利な特質との交換で取得されるものだったが、本作では、まず不利な特質がずらりと並んでおり、主人公の身体能力は標準を大きく下回る。これを標準レベルで開始しようとすると、ゲーム内時間で十年ほど訓練しなければならない。ここから読み取れる本作のメッセージは、「あなたたちの標準的な肉体は、じつは多大な訓練のたまものなのだよ」といった、「気にしていなかったけど実は凄い」という類いのことだろう。そして同時に、現実のゲームにおいて不利な身体的特質をもつと感じている人々が本作に入り込みやすくする意図があるのではないかと思う。

最後に、このレビューは注意喚起のために書かれた。何やら格好良さそうな、他とは違っていそうな、誰もプレイしていなさそうなインディーゲームだと思って本作を手に取るような、珍味を好むプレイヤーを本作は容赦なく撃沈するであろう。本作は、ゲームマニアが求めるような最先端の珍味ではなく、非常に原始的な喜びを追求するゲームである。そもそもどこが尖っているのか理解しがたい作品であり、残念ながら私には本作を読み解けるほどの力量と根気がなく、これ以上の評価も難しい。好意的な言い方をすれば、やや詩的で思想性がありそうな雰囲気がある、ゲームメカニクス以外の部分で楽しむシミュレータである。
items.text_zh:
本作是一款非常发人深省的游戏。因为我不太明白它到底哪里有趣。起初的90分钟里，我惊讶地发现没有任何一个有趣之处，而玩了10个小时后，果然还是没有任何一个有趣之处。因此，我觉得本作或许应该被视为一首诗一般的游戏，就像对不懂读法的人来说，诗不过是毫无价值的文字堆砌。

打个比方，如今会因为“按下A键马里奥就会跳起来”而感动的人应该很少了，但本作似乎正是在主张这种在许多作品中早已不再被提及的原始感动。这是一款以宇宙为舞台、不断飞来飞去的游戏，然而操船却不知为何几乎全是手动，必须用上下左右和旋转键细致地操作宇宙船的航向决定以及对接时的位置对准。在一个存在能让宇宙船自由飞行的技术的世界观里，却不能自动操船，这实在难以理解，因此只能认为这种手动操船系统才是本作的重要关键。然而，要求繁琐操作、既费时间又毫无收益的移动，至少对我来说并不愉快。我希望它做成一种能把主要问题集中在移动目的地、或者移动途中会发生什么事件上的结构。

移动到（不知为何）静止在宇宙空间特定坐标的船舶或空间站残骸并进入后，可以回收一部分可再利用的装置。这与其说花费的是游戏内时间，不如说相当耗费现实时间和精力。舱外活动时，为了补充氧气必须多次返回船内，操作很细碎，而且还有什么都不操作的等待时间。那么为什么要回收这些装置呢？是为了卖掉换钱，我起初是这么想的。然而另一方面，只要接取并完成简单的跑腿任务，就能赚到大约拾荒10倍的钱，而且并不怎么费力。也就是说，其实拾荒并不是为了钱而做的。在这个游戏里，生存所需的食物和水只要买就能大量获得。那么，究竟一开始为什么要特意去做残骸回收业呢？就算能回收一台完好无损的空气泵，自己船上的泵也在稳定运转，卖掉也赚不了多少钱，似乎并没有什么特别的好处。如上所述，首先就很难理解去做本作招牌要素——拾荒——的明确意义(*)。

(*) 也许对扩展船只会有帮助。不过，既然已经知道拾荒赚不了钱，为什么还要为了拾荒而把仓库扩展得超过必要程度呢？我认为应该重新审视任务与拾荒之间的收益差距。

此外，前作《NEO Scavenger》以及其他“生存游戏”中也能见到的现实感缺失，在本作中依然存在。首先，物品那不现实的劣化速度依然健在。在我看来，生存一言以蔽之，就是源于“明明只要买就能解决的东西却买不到”的状况。因此，本作中依然可见的那种“东西很多，却不知为何很快劣化”的游戏设计，我认为是源于开发团队放弃思考，因此持否定态度。另外，本作虽然暗示了与宇宙船开发等相关企业的存在，但经济似乎并不运作。在模拟中一旦缺乏现实感，就很难让现实的计划发挥作用，玩家的所作所为也会被贬低为单纯掌握游戏习性的行为。

游戏开始时要进行玩家角色创建，而让我惊讶的是，游戏一开始就固定为拥有大量对游戏不利的身体特质的状态。回想前作《NEO Scavenger》，不利特质是通过与有利特质交换来取得的，但在本作中，首先排列着一大堆不利特质，主角的身体能力大大低于标准。若想以标准水平开始，就必须在游戏内时间里训练大约十年。从这里能读出的本作讯息，大概是“你们所谓的标准肉体，其实是大量训练的成果哦”这种“平时没在意，其实很厉害”之类的话。同时，我觉得它也有让在现实游戏中感到自己拥有不利身体特质的人更容易进入本作的意图。

最后，这篇评测是为了提醒注意而写的。若有人觉得这似乎是款很酷、与众不同、好像没人玩过的独立游戏，从而入手本作，那么本作将会毫不留情地击沉这种喜好珍味的玩家。本作并不是游戏发烧友所追求的那种最前沿珍味，而是一款追求非常原始喜悦的游戏。它本来就是一部让人难以理解究竟哪里尖锐的作品，遗憾的是，我没有足够的能力和耐心去解读本作，也很难再给出更多评价。说得客气一点，这是一款略带诗意、似乎有些思想性氛围、在游戏机制以外的部分享受的模拟器。

items.text:
não me leve a mal, eu gostei pakas do jogo e joguei bastante antes de comprar com um amigo meu, mas cara... esse jogo não é nem um pouco amigavel pra iniciantes e pra todo mundo em geral, você tem tanta coisa pra controlar ao mesmo tempo, você tem que cuidar da tua nave, enquanto controla ela, enquanto controla seu personagem que tem emoções e que tem necessidades que tem amigos e familia e que tem pessoas que trabalham na nave com ele que também tem suas necessidades e emoções e que além disso tem relacionamentos com você que se tu não tomar cuidado pode acabar zoando com todo seu negocio e além disso tudo o jogo te faz começa com um personagem cheio de debuff que tu tem que tirar usando os poucos anos que teu personagem tem só pra tirar, e sim teu personagem tem idade e quanto mais velho pior, ent ou você começa o jogo com seus belos 18 anos e todo zoado ou você começa aos seus 30 ANOS no minimo pra ter 0 debuffs.

esse jogo é basicamente um chute nas bolas, só compre se tu quer sofrer ou espera ele lança que quem sabe até lá o jogo não bota um tutorial e tira umas mecanicas inuteis tipo as 300 barras sociais e simplifica pra algo mais digestivel.
items.text_zh:
别误会我，我超喜欢这游戏，在和一个朋友一起买之前就玩了很多，但是兄弟……这游戏对新手和所有人来说都一点都不友好，你要同时控制那么多东西，你得照顾你的飞船，一边操控它，一边操控你的角色，角色有情绪、有需求、有朋友和家人，还有和他一起在船上工作的人，那些人也有自己的需求和情绪，除此之外他们还和你有人际关系，如果你不小心，可能会把整个生意都搞砸，而且除此之外，游戏还让你一开始就带着一个满是减益效果的角色，你得用你角色仅剩的几年时间来消除这些减益，是的，你的角色有年龄，越老越糟，所以你要么在18岁开始游戏而且一团糟，要么至少30岁开始才能有0个减益。

这游戏基本上就是往蛋蛋上踹一脚，只有你想受苦才买，或者等它发布，说不定到那时候游戏会加个教程，去掉一些没用的机制，比如那300条社交条，简化成更容易消化的东西。

observations.description: 角色初始带有负面状态，需要花费游戏时间移除，且年龄增长会加剧问题。
observations.evidence: o jogo te faz começa com um personagem cheio de debuff que tu tem que tirar usando os poucos anos que teu personagem tem só pra tirar, e sim teu personagem tem idade e quanto mais velho pior
observations.evidence_zh: 游戏让你开局就带着一个满是减益的角色，你得用角色仅剩的没几年时间专门去消除这些减益，没错，你的角色有年龄，越老越糟

items.text:
Caveat Emptor: This is a game with a lot of potential, but also a game that shouldn't have been released for sale until it was further along. 

I've played hundreds of hours of NeoScavenger (a game by the same dev) and it's become one of my favorite games of all time. I think with enough time Ostranauts will get there. This game really has no gameplay as of right now, you can dock with a space station but character creation is very limited and I've yet to see any... well... actual story. 

This is one of the major risks of paying for an early access game, and I fear this may be one of those games I forget about for five years until it's actually done and then get a chance to get into. So if you want to support the development of a really neat game, go for it!

But if you want something you can actually play right now and have fun with... I'd wait a little while. $20 is a bit steep for what it is.
items.text_zh:
买家当心：这是一款潜力巨大的游戏，但也是一款在进一步完善之前就不应该发售的游戏。

我玩了几百个小时的NeoScavenger（同一开发者的游戏），它已经成为我史上最喜欢的游戏之一。我认为只要有足够的时间，Ostranauts也会达到那个水平。这款游戏目前真的没有什么玩法，你可以对接空间站，但角色创建非常有限，而且我还没有看到任何……嗯……真正的故事。

这是为抢先体验游戏付费的主要风险之一，我担心这可能是我会忘记五年直到它真正完成然后才有机会投入进去的游戏之一。所以如果你想支持一款非常棒的游戏开发，那就去买吧！

但如果你想要现在就能实际玩并且享受乐趣的东西……我会再等一段时间。20美元对于目前的内容来说有点贵。
